requirements.title: Agent-Manager Trusted Patch Application
requirements.description: Provide an explicit agent-manager apply-at-run-end contract with source attribution, run metadata, typed conflict handling, and request-shape parity.

validation.notes: Apply-at-run-end endpoint forwards the trusted agent-manager source and run metadata.
The request contract preserves run identity, source, and auditability fields.
Malformed trusted-apply requests fail at the API boundary.
